trailhead.label: Car park below Malga Coot, Val Resia, the board’s start

cautions: Ibex and chamois on the steeper slopes: keep your dog on the lead.
Cows may graze the pastures in summer.
Not advised in bad weather or the hottest summer hours.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
